title: Rich link previews
notes: Paste a link on its own line and it becomes a rich preview card — the page's title, description, image and site, pulled from its Open Graph tags. Plus the new free Role-Play extension in the Marketplace, the role-play core hooks, Ask moved into the left sidebar, and the reading-scrubber footer fix.

changelog.text: Rich link previews: paste a link on its own line and it becomes a preview card (title, description, image, site) from the page's Open Graph tags — cached and fetched safely.
The free Role-Play extension is now in the Marketplace — characters, post-as-character, role-play topics, a dice roller, character sheets and a character directory.
Ask now sits in the left sidebar under the categories list.
The reading-progress scrubber no longer overlaps the footer at the bottom of a thread.
